Text.label: This component simulates dual port SRAM. CircuitVerse doesn't have  a dual port function, so we fake it.

constructorParamaters: This component simulates dual port SRAM. CircuitVerse doesn't have  a dual port function, so we fake it.

Text.label: This means we need to tie DataA and DataB (write inputs) together as DataIn. We can't write to two different addresses at once.

constructorParamaters: This means we need to tie DataA and DataB (write inputs) together as DataIn. We can't write to two different addresses at once.

Text.label: Further, since the simulator can't read and write to the same address, we use clock edge low to read, clock edge high to write and fake the dual port support.

constructorParamaters: Further, since the simulator can't read and write to the same address, we use clock edge low to read, clock edge high to write and fake the dual port support.

Text.label: We use twice the memory to save two copies of the data so we can read from two different addresses at once.
